## Clinical Benefits & Indications
- Restores healthy cervical lordosis after prolonged screen and desk time.
- Releases suboccipital tension headaches and upper trapezius knots.
- Alleviates compressed C1-C7 discs through gentle gravity traction (no wires, pulleys, or batteries).
- Features dual-traction modes: Convex side for gentle beginner decompression; Concave side for deep therapeutic alignment.
